H200.goodFor: Large-memory AI training and inference, and supported FP64 scientific computation.
H200.limitations: A model and its working state must fit in 141 GB per GPU or be explicitly distributed. Multiple GPUs require parallel software, not just a larger allocation.

L40S.goodFor: FP32 and mixed-precision AI, inference, rendering, and independent GPU jobs.
L40S.limitations: FP64-heavy scientific solvers and communication-heavy multi-GPU jobs. These cards lack NVLink and have 48 GB each.

A100.goodFor: Supported mixed-precision AI and FP64 scientific workloads.
A100.limitations: Memory is per GPU, not an automatically combined pool. ICER’s 80 GB SXM and 40 GB PCIe configurations differ in both capacity and NVLink connectivity.

V100S.goodFor: Compatible CUDA workloads and FP64 scientific computation fitting within 32 GB per GPU.
V100S.limitations: Large models beyond 32 GB per GPU, newer GPU-specific features, and assuming every nvf node has identical NVLink wiring.

V100.goodFor: Compatible CUDA scientific workloads and explicitly parallel multi-GPU work.
V100.limitations: Large per-GPU memory requirements and software requiring newer GPU architectures. Eight cards do not automatically form a single memory pool.
